text: LOCTITE is a brand of Henkel AG & Co. KGaA: Henkel groups Loctite among the technology cluster brands of its Henkel Adhesive Technologies industrial portfolio.
short: LOCTITE is an adhesives brand of Henkel.

source.name: Henkel: Henkel Adhesive Technologies
source.quote: Our industrial product portfolio is organized into five technology cluster brands - Loctite, Technomelt, Bonderite, Teroson and Aquence.
source.note: Corporate page, no date shown; opened 2026-09-30.
